name: contoso_china_sports_8_orders
notes: Isolated 8-order deterministic acceptance fixture; embed by consuming the main-tenant quota, never by appending beyond 1,000,000.
All nominal amount_cent fields are nonnegative. The type-specific financial_effects mapping defines ledger signs.
A PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED callback is intentionally duplicated with the same payment_id/provider_transaction_id. Logical core.payment must contain one row per payment_id.
UNIT_SHIPPED and UNIT_DELIVERED are unit-level records. Rows sharing shipment_event_id map to one core.shipment_event and all its shipment_item units.
Return receipt is quarantine; acceptance reverses sales; restock reverses original COGS; refund changes cash only.
RETURN_DAMAGED is damage classification while physical goods remain on site. It is not physical SCRAP/DISPOSAL and never reverses COGS.
Source stock in_transit here means internal replenishment/transfer transit; outbound-to-customer units are represented by shipment state and do not enter site in_transit_qty.
Both occurred_at and available_at must be strictly below their respective cutoffs. F008 late delivery is effective 2025-12-31 and first available 2026-01-02.
No fees, VAT, new orders in 2026, or additional post-cutoff outcomes are included.

field_mapping.occurred_at: event_at / recognized_at / attempted_at according to event type
field_mapping.amount_cent: nominal event amount; signs derived by financial_effects
field_mapping.RETURN_DAMAGED: core.return_event.event_type = DAMAGED; core.inventory_movement.quarantine_delta = -1, damaged_delta = +1; no revenue/COGS/cash entry
field_mapping.damaged_inventory: core.inventory_movement.damaged_delta and core.inventory_snapshot.damaged_qty; only SCRAPPED physically removes damaged stock

time_contract.all_timestamps: ISO-8601 Asia/Shanghai offset +08:00; normalize to UTC on import if required
time_contract.reference_time: Anchor for relative language only; never the machine current time
time_contract.period_start: Inclusive lower bound for period reports
time_contract.period_end: Exclusive upper bound; identical to business_as_of for period gold
time_contract.alias_fields: business_before and knowledge_before are retained exact aliases for loader convenience; reference_time defaults to business_as_of in this fixture
